events.title: Werner Vogels named Amazon CTO
events.summary: Amazon appointed Werner Vogels chief technology officer in September 2005 — evangelizing the distributed systems behind AWS.
events.about: Vogels coined 'everything fails all the time' and championed eventual consistency, service-oriented architecture, and cloud primitives. His blog and talks shaped how developers design for failure at scale.

narrative.whyChosen: Vogels became the public technical voice of Amazon's infrastructure revolution.
narrative.whyImportant: He translated AWS's distributed systems lessons into mainstream engineering practice.
narrative.problemSolved: Enterprises lacked accessible guidance on building reliable large-scale web services.
